name: Summon Clockwork Warriors
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level cleric/oracle 8, sorcerer/wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (a gear and a spring)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect 2d4+2 clockwork soldiers
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You speak a word of animation as the gear and spring call forth a strike-force of clockwork warriors. When you cast this spell you summon 2d4+2 clockwork soldiers that attack your foes. As a move action each round you may designate an enemy and all clockwork soldiers will use their actions to move towards or attack that enemy until given another command. If not given any orders, the soldiers will each target the nearest enemy to themselves.
